description: This Java source file defines a UI Automator test case that navigates through the Android Settings app to retrieve and log the build number. It includes helper classes for interacting with launcher and settings UI elements, methods for automation steps such as opening the app, navigating to the About section, and extracting specific information.

classes.name: LogBuildNumber
classes.description: Main test case class extending UiAutomatorTestCase, responsible for setting up, executing the test, and cleaning up.

classes.name: LauncherHelper
classes.description: Helper class containing UiSelector constants for launcher UI elements like the All Apps button and launcher items.

classes.name: SettingsHelper
classes.description: Helper class with UiSelector constants for the Settings list view and its items.

methods.name: testDemo
methods.description: Main test method that automates launching the Settings app, navigating to About, and reading the Build number.

methods.name: selectSettingsFor
methods.description: Helper method to select a specific settings item by name, scrolling if necessary.

methods.name: getAboutItem
methods.description: Retrieves the text value for a specified About item, handling multiple list views if needed.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Overrides the setup method; calls the superclass method (initializes test environment).

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Overrides the teardown method; calls the superclass method (cleans up after test).
